theme: practical and institutional transmission beyond decipherment
question: Which practices and organizational relations could survive settlement reorganization and contribute to mature early Indian textual institutions?
outcome: Fourteen works or editions supply 30 observations and seven claims. Developed a selective-survival mechanism through households, apprenticeships, patrons and specialist teaching. Rice uncertainty reassignment preserves one narrow Masudpur VII direction but broader ranges overlap and no quantified PGW domestication endpoint is available. Corrected eligibility gives five initial hypotheses, two source-reported intermediate archaeological candidates and zero diagnostic cross-domain joins. DN16 supplies an observed conceptual transfer of meeting principles across institutions.
challenge: Crop occurrence, scaled assemblage percentages, divine role lists, finished beads and legendary policy accounts represent different observations. The first filter did not require a retained linked text after removing textual observations. The preliminary Sanauli comparison does not establish local manufacturing.
remedy: Retained source loci, competing routes, strata and uncertainty; preserved audit.py/run-v1, documented an amendment and wrote audit-v2/run-v2 separately. Independent review reproduced filters and visually checked rice Tables 2-4. Four prospective tests specify production, recovery and textual controls.
retry_when: Independently dated intermediate production contexts, recovery-controlled farming evidence or assessed role-action loci distinguish unusual linked practices from imports, convergence, inherited Indo-Iranian repertoires or later institutional construction. Additional generic similarities alone do not identify a route.
